record.title: DfCM reachable frontier
record.body: R78 adds a legality-first ready-set morphism after R77 exact repository-universe observation: RepositorySnapshot -> downstream demand -> hard admissibility -> ready set -> capital measure -> preserve compatible Pareto alternatives -> choose execution-edge linear extension -> deterministic GGEN allocation plan -> exact qualification. Newly reachable edges: (1) revalidate current R76 structural-capital compiler only when its predecessor/currentness gates enter READY; (2) revalidate R74 structural-option factory independently; (3) map R77 repository snapshots into R78 candidate facts; (4) manufacture all concurrently READY cross-repo consumers rather than serializing them; (5) return generalizable consumer refinements upstream and regenerate/requalify; (6) measure T/G/D/F/U/Y/M and dual RevOps from receipts. Weakest multiplier remains qualified cross-repository fanout. 1000X NOT_ADMITTED.
